verdict.rationale: Teams documents first-party Export APIs that export 1:1, group, meeting, and channel messages, including user-deleted messages for up to 21 days. That is a real, product-owned export path for chat data. However, it is an API mechanism rather than a self-serve user export, and the evidence never states the output format or covers anything beyond messages. Missing for 10: confirmation of open/standard export formats, export of files, meetings, recordings and other non-message data, a user-facing self-service 'download all my data' flow, and independent hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Teams Export APIs allow you to export 1:1, group chat, meeting chats, and channel messages from Microsoft Teams.
Messages deleted by users from the Teams client can be accessed using export APIs up to 21 days from the time of deletion.
